support_classes.ACTIVE_RUNTIME: must execute, test, integrate, deploy, observe, and recover
support_classes.PRODUCT: must provide a complete user workflow, production deployment, E2E proof, privacy and operational controls
support_classes.LIBRARY_OR_SDK: must expose a stable interface, package or consumable release, downstream integration proof, versioning and compatibility policy
support_classes.CONTROL_PLANE: must enforce state/authority boundaries, produce receipts, fail safely, and be exercised by at least one real downstream system
support_classes.PROOF_SYSTEM: must have reproducible execution, exact-source evidence, public-safe discoverability, and bounded claims
support_classes.COMPANY_ALIGNED_SYSTEM: must provide company-relevant technical capability with non-affiliation boundaries, current proof and a role-specific application projection
support_classes.PRIVATE_SUPPORT: must remain private, executable where appropriate, provenance-complete, redaction-safe and integrated through explicit contracts
support_classes.DONOR: must preserve lineage and either expose a reusable mechanism or be composed into a stronger active system without losing the donor repository
support_classes.REFERENCE: must be technically coherent, reproducible where runnable, limitation-explicit and discoverable from the estate graph
support_classes.HISTORICAL: must preserve provenance, freeze historical claims to dated state, link to successors and never impersonate current authority

identity: default branch and current head known
integration: exact version or commit lineage where needed
no second truth authority created by projection
operations: outcome feedback where the system changes real workflows

terminal_definition.active_repo: EVOLVABLE with live or published readback and no known P0/P1 completion blocker
terminal_definition.historical_repo: provenance-complete, successor-linked, immutable historical boundary enforced
terminal_definition.estate: every retained repository has exactly one explicit strongest role, an evidence-backed completion state, an integration/discovery path, and no untracked deployment or verification gap
